<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Customers:</b> For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, the Company had <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1619">two</span> customers, Customer A and Customer B, which accounted for approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c1620" contextRef="d_2024-10-01_2025-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerAMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">18</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction id="c1621" contextRef="d_2024-10-01_2025-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerBMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">13</ix:nonFraction>% of net sales, respectively. These customers are distributors. For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2024, Customer A and Customer B accounted for approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c1622" contextRef="d_2023-10-01_2024-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerOneMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">20</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction id="c1623" contextRef="d_2023-10-01_2024-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerBMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">15</ix:nonFraction>% of net sales, respectively. For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, Customer A and Customer B accounted for approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c1624" contextRef="d_2022-10-01_2023-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerAMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">19</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction id="c1625" contextRef="d_2022-10-01_2023-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerBMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">10</ix:nonFraction>% of net sales, respectively. These major customers, like our other customers, purchase our products from time to time through purchase orders, and we do not have any agreements that obligate these major customers to purchase products in the future from us.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">As of September 30, 2025, the Company had <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1626">two</span> customers, Customer B and Customer A, which accounted for approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c1627" contextRef="d_2024-10-01_2025-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-AccountsReceivableMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerBMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">17</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction id="c1628" contextRef="d_2024-10-01_2025-09-30_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-AccountsReceivableMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-CustomerAMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">11</ix:nonFraction>% of accounts receivable, respectively. <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Disaggregation of Revenue</b>: The Company allocates sales from external customers to geographic areas based on the location to which the product is transported. <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company leases an <ix:nonFraction id="c1687" contextRef="i_2015-01-01_StatementGeographicalAxis-WinnetkaAvenueNorthBrooklynParkMinnesotaMember" unitRef="SquareFoot" name="us-gaap:AreaOfRealEstateProperty" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">85,000</ix:nonFraction> square foot facility at 7050 Winnetka Avenue North, Brooklyn Park, Minnesota consisting of corporate offices, manufacturing, and warehouse space. The original lease term was <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1688">ten</span> years and two months, ending on February 28, 2025, with a renewal option. In April 2024, the Company exercised the renewal option, which extended the lease term <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1689">three</span> additional years to end on February 29, 2028. The exercise of the renewal option added a right of use asset and corresponding lease liability of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1690" contextRef="d_2025-04-01_2025-04-30_StatementGeographicalAxis-WinnetkaAvenueNorthBrooklynParkMinnesotaMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOperatingLeaseLiability" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,337,000</ix:nonFraction> upon lease commencement.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company indirectly leases an approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c1691" contextRef="i_2024-04-30_StatementGeographicalAxis-TijuanaMexico3Member" unitRef="SquareFoot" name="us-gaap:AreaOfRealEstateProperty" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">318,000</ix:nonFraction> square foot manufacturing facility in Tijuana, Mexico that operates as a Maquiladora. The lease commenced in April 2024, and has a term of <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1692">seven</span> years, of which <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1693">five</span> years are mandatory. The lease contains two options to extend the term of the lease for additional periods of <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1694">five</span> years each. The lease calls for monthly base rental payments of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c1695" contextRef="d_2024-04-01_2024-04-30_StatementGeographicalAxis-TijuanaMexico3Member" unitRef="USD" name="clfd:OperatingLeaseMonthlyPayment" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">169,000</ix:nonFraction>, increasing <ix:nonFraction id="c1696" contextRef="d_2024-04-01_2024-04-30_StatementGeographicalAxis-TijuanaMexico3Member" unitRef="Pure" name="clfd:OperatingLeasePaymentsAnnualIncreasePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">2</ix:nonFraction>% annually. <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company leases a <ix:nonFraction id="c1697" contextRef="i_2021-11-19_StatementGeographicalAxis-BrooklynParkMNMember" unitRef="SquareFoot" name="us-gaap:AreaOfRealEstateProperty" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">105,000</ix:nonFraction> square foot warehouse and manufacturing facility in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota. The lease includes an option to extend the lease for an additional <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1699">five</span> years. The renewal option has not been included within the lease term because it is not reasonably certain that the Company will exercise the option.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Note 10. Debt</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On April 27, 2022, the Company entered into a loan agreement and a security agreement with a bank that provides the Company with a $<ix:nonFraction id="c1750" contextRef="i_2022-04-01_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">40,000,000</ix:nonFraction> revolving line of credit that is secured by certain of the Company’s U.S. assets. The original maturity date of the line of credit was April 27, 2025. Borrowed amounts bear interest at a variable rate of the CME Group one-month term <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1751">Secured Overnight Financing Rate</span> (“SOFR”) plus <ix:nonFraction id="c1752" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2022-04-01_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">1.85</ix:nonFraction>%, but not less than <ix:nonFraction id="c1753" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2022-04-01_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="Pure" name="clfd:DebtInstrumentMinimumInterestRateRequired" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">1.80</ix:nonFraction>% per annum. As of September 30, 2025, the interest rate was <ix:nonFraction id="c1754" contextRef="d_2024-10-01_2025-09-30_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">6.17</ix:nonFraction>%. The loan agreement and the security agreement contain customary affirmative and negative covenants and requirements relating to the Company and its operations. On August 5, 2024, the Company entered into an amendment to the loan agreement that, among other things, (i) eliminated the requirement that the Company maintain a debt service coverage ratio of not less than <ix:nonFraction id="c1755" contextRef="d_2024-08-05_2024-08-05_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="Pure" name="clfd:DebtInstrumentCovenantMinimumDebtServiceCoverageRatio" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">1.20</ix:nonFraction> to 1 as of the end of each fiscal year for the fiscal year then ended and that the Company maintain a debt to cash flow ratio of not greater than <ix:nonFraction id="c1756" contextRef="d_2024-08-05_2024-08-05_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="Pure" name="clfd:DebtInstrumentCovenantMaximumDebtToCashFlowRatio" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2</ix:nonFraction> to 1 measured as of the end of each of the Company’s fiscal quarters for the trailing 12 month period; (ii) added a requirement that the Company maintain accounts with the bank with a minimum aggregate liquidity of unrestricted and unencumbered cash and cash equivalents at all times of not less than the outstanding principal balance of the Company’s revolving credit promissory note payable to the bank; and (iii) waived the Company’s compliance with the debt to cash flow ratio for the fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2024.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On April 25, 2025, the Company entered into an amendment to the loan agreement that extended the maturity of the line of credit from April 27, 2025, to April 25, 2026.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">As of September 30, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company had <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1757"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1758"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1759">no</span></span></span> borrowings against this line of credit. As of September 30, 2025, 2024, and 2023, the Company was in compliance with all applicable covenants. The line of credit is collateralized by Clearfield, Inc’s assets of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1760" contextRef="i_2025-09-30_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LoanAndSecurityAgreementWithBremerBankNationalAssociationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCollateralAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">274,219,000</ix:nonFraction> as of September 30, 2025.</p>
</ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Note 11. Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">During the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025, the Company committed to a plan to sell its Nestor Cables business. As of September 30, 2025, the criteria for classification as held for sale under ASC 205-20 were met. Accordingly, the assets and liabilities of the Nestor Cables business have been classified as held for sale in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets as of September 30, 2025.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On November 11, 2025, the Company completed the sale of its Nestor Cables business. In connection with this sale, the historical results of the Nestor Cables business and certain assets and liabilities of this business are reported in our consolidated financial statements as discontinued operations.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Upon classification as held for sale, the Nestor Cables disposal group was measured at the lower of its carrying amount or fair value less costs to sell. Fair value was primarily based on the estimated selling price derived from a negotiated purchase agreement with a third-party buyer, adjusted for estimated transaction costs. The fair value measurement utilized Level 2 inputs within the fair value hierarchy under ASC 820. As the carrying amount of the disposal group exceeded its estimated fair value less costs to sell, the Company recorded a total impairment charge of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1764" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-09-30_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-NestorCablesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationProvisionForLossGainOnDisposalBeforeIncomeTax" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">16,589,000</ix:nonFraction>, which includes $<ix:nonFraction id="c1765" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-09-30_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-NestorCablesMember" unitRef="USD" name="clfd:DiscontinuedOperationsEstimatedTransactionCostsOnDisposal" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,489,000</ix:nonFraction> of estimated transaction costs, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The estimated transaction costs are recorded as a contra asset within the Company’s consolidated balance sheets. The total impairment charge was also comprised of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1766" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-09-30_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-NestorCablesMember" unitRef="USD" name="clfd:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsGoodwillImpairment" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">2,022,000</ix:nonFraction> related to the impairment of goodwill and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1767" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-09-30_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-NestorCablesMember" unitRef="USD" name="clfd:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationImpairmentOfLonglivedAssets" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">13,078,000</ix:nonFraction> related to the impairment of the long-lived assets of the disposal group. The total impairment charge, inclusive of estimated transaction costs, is reflected within Loss from impairment of discontinued operations before income taxes in the consolidated statements of earnings for the year ended September 30, 2025.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Note 12. Segment Reporting</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Following the classification of the Nestor Cables business as discontinued operations during the year ended September 30, 2025, the Company’s continuing operations represent one operating segment and <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1943">one</span> reportable segment. All segment information related to the discontinued Nestor Cables business has been excluded from continuing operations and is presented separately in Note 11 – Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company’s chief operating decision maker (CODM) is the Chief Executive Officer. The CODM reviews financial information and makes resource allocation decisions based on consolidated financial results, using net income (loss) as the measure of segment performance. The CODM considers budget-to-actual variances when making decisions regarding the allocation of resources and assessing performance of the segment. The components of net income (loss) reviewed by the CODM, including significant segment expenses, are identical to the captions presented in the Company’s consolidated statements of earnings. Amounts for additional information required by ASC 280, <i>Segment Reporting</i>, including depreciation and amortization expense, stock-based compensation expense, and capital expenditures are identical to those presented in the Company’s consolidated statements of cash flows. Because the financial information used by the CODM is at the same level of detail as that presented in the consolidated financial statements, no additional segment information is presented. The measure of segment assets is reported on the consolidated balance sheets as total consolidated assets. In addition, a description of the types of products and services from which the reportable segment derives its revenues as well as the entity-wide information can be found in Note 7 – Concentrations.</p>
</ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<div> </div>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Note 13. Subsequent Events</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt;">On November 11, 2025, the Company completed the divestiture of its wholly owned subsidiary, Clearfield Finland Oy, parent company of Nestor Cables Oy, for $<ix:nonFraction id="c1947" contextRef="d_2025-11-11_2025-11-11_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-ClearfieldFinlandOyMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesAndInterestsInAffiliates" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1</ix:nonFraction> in cash and the contribution from the Company to Clearfield Finland Oy of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1948" contextRef="d_2025-11-11_2025-11-11_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-ClearfieldFinlandOyMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USD" name="clfd:ReceivablesAcquiredFromDivestitureOfBusinessesAndInterestsInAffiliates" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">5,785,000</ix:nonFraction> of inter-company receivables owed to the Company by Nestor Cables Oy and Clearfield Finland Oy. See Note 11 for further details.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">On November 20, 2025, the Company’s board of directors increased the Company’s share repurchase program from $<ix:nonFraction id="c1949" contextRef="i_2025-11-19_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-StockRepurchaseProgramMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USD" name="srt:StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">65,000,000</ix:nonFraction> to $<ix:nonFraction id="c1950" contextRef="i_2025-11-20_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-StockRepurchaseProgramMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USD" name="srt:StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">85,000,000</ix:nonFraction> commencing November 28, 2025, and continuing for an indefinite period or until terminated by the board of directors.</p>
</ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>ITEM 9.</b>         <b>CHANGES IN AND DISAGREEMENTS WITH ACCOUNTANTS ON ACCOUNTING AND FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE<a id="item9" href="#"></a></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">None.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>ITEM 9A.</b>         <b>CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES<a id="item9a" href="#"></a></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Disclosure Controls and Procedures </b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company’s management carried out an evaluation, under the supervision and with the participation of the Company’s Chief Executive Officer and the Company’s Chief Financial Officer of the effectiveness of the design and operation of the Company’s disclosure controls and procedures (as such term is defined in Rule 13a-15(e) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) as of September 30, 2025. Based upon that evaluation, the Company’s Chief Executive Officer and the Company’s Chief Financial Officer concluded that the Company’s disclosure controls and procedures were effective.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Management</b>’<b>s Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting </b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Our management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting, as such term is defined in Rule 13a-15(f) and 15d-15(f) of the Exchange Act. Under the supervision and with the participation of our management, including our Chief Executive Officer and our Chief Financial Officer, we conducted an evaluation of the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting as of September 30, 2025 based on the framework in the 2013 <i>Internal Control </i>–<i> Integrated Framework</i> issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO). Based on that evaluation, management concluded that, as of September 30, 2025, our internal control over financial reporting was effective. The effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting as of September 30, 2025 has been audited by Deloitte & Touche LLP, an independent registered public accounting firm, as stated in their report included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Changes in Internal Control over Financial Reporting </b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt;">The Company has adopted a Code of Ethics and Business Conduct that applies to our principal executive officer, principal financial officer, principal accounting officer, all officers, directors, and employees of the Company. <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2024-10-01_2025-09-30" name="ecd:InsiderTrdPoliciesProcAdoptedFlag" id="c1961" format="ixt:fixed-true">has an insider trading policy</ix:nonNumeric> governing the purchase, sale, and/or other dispositions of our securities by our directors, executive officers and employees that we believe is reasonably designed to promote compliance with insider trading laws, rules and regulations, and the exchange listing standards applicable to us. A copy of our insider trading policy, as amended, is incorporated by reference as Exhibit 19 to this Annual Report on Form 10-K.</p>
